definitions.explanation: A vision condition where distant objects appear blurry.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{近視|きんし}です。
{近視|きんし}{用|よう}の{眼鏡|めがね}

notes:
{近視|きんし} is a common vision condition.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {近視|きんし}になる (to become nearsighted)
- {近視|きんし}が{進|すす}む (nearsightedness progresses)
- {近視|きんし}を{矯正|きょうせい}する (to correct nearsightedness)

DEGREES:
- {強度|きょうど}{近視|きんし} (severe myopia)
- {軽度|けいど}{近視|きんし} (mild myopia)

CONTRAST:
- {近視|きんし} (nearsightedness - can't see far)
- {遠視|えんし} (farsightedness - can't see near)
- {乱視|らんし} (astigmatism)
- {老眼|ろうがん} (presbyopia - age-related)
